scope: Repo-grounded capability-to-building map. Describes features implemented, manually operated, shared-platform, disabled-until-configured, or schematic-future according to repository sources. It does not independently verify public factual claims inside program content.

status_vocabulary.built_manual: Public flow exists but completion is human/manual.
status_vocabulary.built_disabled_until_configured: Implementation exists but external credentials/provider/agreements/configuration are required.
status_vocabulary.built_not_armed_by_default: Underlying system exists but outbound operation is intentionally not enabled by default.
status_vocabulary.built_shared_platform: Implemented in shared McCluster platform and used by Equity Uprise rather than duplicated.
status_vocabulary.built_public_pathway: Public path exists; relationship/fulfillment work is handled institutionally.
status_vocabulary.schematic_future_feasibility: Architectural/digital reservation only, subject to real-world feasibility.
status_vocabulary.experimental_separate: Separate experimental system; optional route, not building authority.

floors.title: Arrival / Orientation / Intake
floors.role: arrival / orientation / trust / verification / Development Passport / next-action routing
private_surfaces: Live B1 / Underground Operations interface (hidden from ordinary navigation)
floors.rule: This floor receives and orients people, establishes/continues Development Passport state, performs intake/verification, and routes participants to the next appropriate action. It does not expose privileged workflow, financial, relationship, live B1, or underground operational state.

floors.title: Public Forum
floors.rule: Public issue framing remains neutral; private dashboard content is visible only after member authentication.

floors.title: Fellowship + Network
floors.rule: Public people/opportunity surfaces include the Equity Uprise cohort, external fellowships and enterprise-development information while keeping private contact, fit-review, revenue/accounting and relationship notes non-public.

floors.title: Media + Culture
floors.rule: Rights, DDEX and delivery state stay operational/private; the public floor expresses the catalogue, culture and approved work.

floors.title: Policy + Proof
floors.rule: This floor is the canonical research-to-record engine; approval authority for irreversible external acts remains on Floor 6.

floors.title: Penthouse Command
public_surfaces: Public institutional mode of Command Wall
Halo Globe / Spatial Intelligence (sanitized public mode)
floors.rule: Private control/admin/outreach/funding functions remain access-controlled. The Halo Globe is visible to all, but public/member/staff layers are read-only and entitlement-scoped; only protected owner/admin mode may enter operational Halo controls.

floors.title: Roof / Mobility Portal
floors.rule: Passenger-elevator roof service is not assumed. Mobility remains a candidate reservation pending real-world feasibility.

rules: Do not create a separate physical room for every backend table or API.
Every capability must have a primary floor or be explicitly excluded from physical representation.
Public/private boundaries in the source product must survive the building metaphor.
High-risk actions remain approval-gated and are never exposed as anonymous/public hotspots.
Shared McCluster systems used by Equity Uprise are represented where they matter to the program, but the building does not pretend Equity Uprise owns a duplicate stack.
Political/public-issue surfaces represent neutral discussion, evidence and participation; the building does not encode a partisan position.
Generated plans, 3D and hotspots must derive from this map plus Core V2 floor programs.
Enterprise Development is represented as a program lane, not a pricing billboard; changing commercial terms never changes building geometry.
The detailed Equity Uprise Mission Fund remains visually quiet until its governance/custody/accounting/reporting state is publishable.
The Equity Uprise cohort is distinct from the external fellowship directory and must remain visible as its own program record.
Hitman's Halo remains a shared McCluster spatial-intelligence system; Equity Uprise consumes a permissioned projection and never becomes the spatial source of truth.
